input.quote: Contractor will be compensated on a time and materials.
input.rationale: Compensation is time-and-materials under individual Statements of Work with no minimum purchase, retainer floor, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic and no volume caps on us. Nothing to redline.

input.quote: Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination. Contractor shall provide to Company, and hereby assigns to Company, all right, title and interest to any Works in progress.
input.rationale: Termination only addresses payment and assignment of Works in progress — there is no transition assistance, no obligation to return our data or Confidential Information in a usable format and no deletion/certification obligation. We inserted a wind-down paragraph at 6(d) (six months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day data return, certified deletion).
